verdict.rationale: Unreal documents its own testing environments: toolbar play-testing of the loaded Level, an Automation Test Framework for unit, feature and stress tests, and Gauntlet for running test sessions with clients and servers. These give an AI-native user isolated places to exercise a project. None of the evidence says these environments are walled off from live or production data, so the sandbox-isolation core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented isolation from production data or live services, an explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, agent-facing sandbox access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
